10
1Anuanom, m’akoma mu adeɛ a mepɛ, ne me nkoto a mekoto mesrɛ Onyankopɔn mema wɔn ne sɛ, wɔbɛnya nkwa. 2Na medi wɔn adanseɛ sɛ wɔwɔ Nyankopɔn ho mmɔdemmɔ deɛ, nanso wɔnni no nimdeɛ mu. 3#Rom 9.31-32 Na wɔnnim Nyankopɔn tenenee no, na wɔhwehwɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn ara tenenee si hɔ nti, wɔmmrɛɛ wɔn ho ase nhyɛɛ Nyankopɔn tenenee ase. 4#Mat 5.17; Heb 8.13; Yoh 3.18 Na Kristo ne mmara no awieeɛ a ɛma wɔn a wɔgye die nyinaa kɔ tenenee mu.
Nkwagyeɛ wɔ hɔ ma obiara
5 # Lew 18.5 Na Mose twerɛ tenenee a ɛfiri mmara mu no ho asɛm sɛ: Onipa ko a ɔdi yei soɔ no bɛnya mu nkwa. 6#Deut 30.12-13 Na sɛdeɛ tenenee a ɛfiri gyidie mu no ka nie: Nka no w’akoma mu sɛ: Hwan na ɔbɛforo akɔ soro? (Ɛne sɛ, sɛ wɔde Kristo bɛsiane); 7anaasɛ hwan na ɔbɛsiane akɔ ebunu mu? (Ɛne sɛ, sɛ wɔde Kristo bɛfiri awufoɔ mu aba). 8#Deut 30.14 Na mmom ɛse sɛn?
Asɛm no abɛn wo,
w’anomu ne w’akoma mu,
(ɛno ne gyidie asɛm a yɛbɔ no dawuro no). 9#Eks 4.5 Na sɛ wode w’ano pae mu ka sɛ Yesu ne Awurade, na wode w’akoma gye di sɛ Onyankopɔn anyane no afiri awufoɔ mu a, wɔbɛgye wo nkwa. 10Na akoma na wɔde gye di kɔ tenenee mu, na ano na wɔde pae mu ka kɔ nkwagyeɛ mu. 11#Yes 28.16 Na atwerɛ no se: Obiara a ɔgye no die no ani renwu. 12#Aso 10.34; 15.9 Na nsonsonoeɛ biara nni Yudani ne Helani ntam; ɛfiri sɛ Awurade korɔ no ara na ɔdi wɔn nyinaa soɔ, na ɔwɔ ahonyadeɛ ma wɔn a wɔfrɛ no nyinaa. 13#Yoel 2.32 Na obiara a ɔbɛbɔ Awurade din no bɛnya nkwa.
14 # 1 Ti 4.16 Na afei ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na wɔbɛfrɛ deɛ wɔnnye no nnie? Nanso ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na wɔbɛgye deɛ wɔntee ne ho asɛm no adie? Nanso sɛ ɔsɛnkafoɔ nni hɔ a, ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na wɔbɛteɛ? 15#Yes 52.7 Nanso sɛ wɔansoma wɔn a, ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na wɔbɛbɔ asɛm no ho dawuro? Sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ sɛ: Sɛdeɛ nnepa ho asɛmpakafoɔ no anan si yɛ fɛ fa! 16#Yes 53.1 Na ɛnyɛ wɔn nyinaa na wɔtiee asɛmpa no. Na Yesaia ka sɛ: Awurade, hwan na wagye yɛn asɛnka adie? 17#Yoh 17.20 Ɛnneɛ afei na gyidie firi asɛm no tie mu, na otie nam Kristo ho asɛm so ba.
18 # Dwom 19.4 Na mebisa sɛ: Wɔante koraa? Ampa ara wɔate,
wɔn nne firi kɔɔ asase nyinaa so,
na wɔn nsɛm duruu wiase ano.
19 # Deut 32.21 Na mebisa bio sɛ: Israel anhunu? Mose na ɔdi kan ka sɛ:
Mɛma moatwe wɔn a wɔnyɛ ɔman ho ninkunu,
mede ɔman a wɔnnim hwee bɛyi mo abufuo.
20 # Yes 65.1 Na Yesaia nso si ne bo ka sɛ:
Wɔn a wɔnhwehwɛ me no ahu me,
na mayi me ho makyerɛ wɔn a wɔammisa m’akyiri kwan.
21 # Yes 65.2 Na Israelfoɔ ho deɛ, ɔka sɛ: Daa nyinaa metrɛɛ me nsam memaa ɔman asoɔdenfoɔ nyiyianofoɔ.

Anuanom, m’akoma mu adeɛ a mepɛ, ne me nkoto a mekoto mesrɛ Onyankopɔn mema wɔn ne sɛ, wɔbɛnya nkwa. Na medi wɔn adanseɛ sɛ wɔwɔ Nyankopɔn ho mmɔdemmɔ deɛ, nanso wɔnni no nimdeɛ mu. Na wɔnnim Nyankopɔn tenenee no, na wɔhwehwɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn ara tenenee si hɔ nti, wɔmmrɛɛ wɔn ho ase nhyɛɛ Nyankopɔn tenenee ase. Na Kristo ne mmara no awieeɛ a ɛma wɔn a wɔgye die nyinaa kɔ tenenee mu.

Na Mose twerɛ tenenee a ɛfiri mmara mu no ho asɛm sɛ: Onipa ko a ɔdi yei soɔ no bɛnya mu nkwa. Na sɛdeɛ tenenee a ɛfiri gyidie mu no ka nie: Nka no w’akoma mu sɛ: Hwan na ɔbɛforo akɔ soro? (Ɛne sɛ, sɛ wɔde Kristo bɛsiane); anaasɛ hwan na ɔbɛsiane akɔ ebunu mu? (Ɛne sɛ, sɛ wɔde Kristo bɛfiri awufoɔ mu aba). Na mmom ɛse sɛn?
Asɛm no abɛn wo,
w’anomu ne w’akoma mu,
(ɛno ne gyidie asɛm a yɛbɔ no dawuro no). Na sɛ wode w’ano pae mu ka sɛ Yesu ne Awurade, na wode w’akoma gye di sɛ Onyankopɔn anyane no afiri awufoɔ mu a, wɔbɛgye wo nkwa. Na akoma na wɔde gye di kɔ tenenee mu, na ano na wɔde pae mu ka kɔ nkwagyeɛ mu. Na atwerɛ no se: Obiara a ɔgye no die no ani renwu. Na nsonsonoeɛ biara nni Yudani ne Helani ntam; ɛfiri sɛ Awurade korɔ no ara na ɔdi wɔn nyinaa soɔ, na ɔwɔ ahonyadeɛ ma wɔn a wɔfrɛ no nyinaa. Na obiara a ɔbɛbɔ Awurade din no bɛnya nkwa.
Na afei ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na wɔbɛfrɛ deɛ wɔnnye no nnie? Nanso ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na wɔbɛgye deɛ wɔntee ne ho asɛm no adie? Nanso sɛ ɔsɛnkafoɔ nni hɔ a, ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na wɔbɛteɛ? Nanso sɛ wɔansoma wɔn a, ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na wɔbɛbɔ asɛm no ho dawuro? Sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ sɛ: Sɛdeɛ nnepa ho asɛmpakafoɔ no anan si yɛ fɛ fa! Na ɛnyɛ wɔn nyinaa na wɔtiee asɛmpa no. Na Yesaia ka sɛ: Awurade, hwan na wagye yɛn asɛnka adie? Ɛnneɛ afei na gyidie firi asɛm no tie mu, na otie nam Kristo ho asɛm so ba.
Na mebisa sɛ: Wɔante koraa? Ampa ara wɔate,
wɔn nne firi kɔɔ asase nyinaa so,
na wɔn nsɛm duruu wiase ano.
Na mebisa bio sɛ: Israel anhunu? Mose na ɔdi kan ka sɛ:
Mɛma moatwe wɔn a wɔnyɛ ɔman ho ninkunu,
mede ɔman a wɔnnim hwee bɛyi mo abufuo.
Na Yesaia nso si ne bo ka sɛ:
Wɔn a wɔnhwehwɛ me no ahu me,
na mayi me ho makyerɛ wɔn a wɔammisa m’akyiri kwan.
Na Israelfoɔ ho deɛ, ɔka sɛ: Daa nyinaa metrɛɛ me nsam memaa ɔman asoɔdenfoɔ nyiyianofoɔ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
